title: Onboard sagitta-13b-v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds sagitta-13b-v1.0 model metadata, performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets, and automates changelog entry generation for registry releases. Includes quantization guidance and validation tests.
description: Motivation: Onboard sagitta-13b-v1.0 into the model registry so it can be served by Redwood runtime and included in perf benchmarks and release notes. This PR adds the canonical model metadata (model card, licenses, tokenizer+architecture hints), pre-computed performance profiles for representative workloads (128/512/2048 tokens under typical batching), and a changelog automation hook so future registry releases automatically include a curated entry. Changes include metadata, perf JSON, validation tests, and a small automation workflow. Checklist: [x] Add model metadata and model card. [x] Add perf profiles (latency, p95, tokens/sec, cost-est). [x] Add quantization/compatibility notes. [x] Add unit tests for perf profile schema validation. [x] Add changelog automation template and CI job. [x] Run perf canary and verify numbers. Testing notes: perf numbers were produced by perf-canary on dedicated infra (run id perf-2026-02-08-3) and validated against profiler traces. Changelog automation emits an entry to registry-changelog.yaml using the standard template. No behaviorally breaking changes to serving paths. See files changed for details.
